title: Invalid: unsupported encryption algorithm ID
description: SAR archive with an encryption algorithm ID that is not implemented. Must fail closed with an unsupported error.
notes: Hand-crafted: encryption algo ID set to a reserved value.

Regenerated in M13b WP-6 (SAR-M13b-WP6-IMPLEMENTATION-001) with `cargo run -p sar-archive --example generate_crypto_vectors` for the Section 5.3.3 KMS payload layout, HKDF-SHA256 Entry keys and complete Global Header AAD. Entry nonces are random per run, so the bytes are not reproducible.
